title: Chevron Washcloth
description: A bold zigzag washcloth that teaches colour changing and chevron shaping.
expectationText: The rhythmic chevron pattern is addictive. By the end you will master increasing and decreasing in a single row without losing count.

steps.title: Start with colour A
steps.instruction: Chain 42 with colour A. The stitch count needs to be a multiple of 10 plus 2 for the turning chain.

steps.title: Row 1 (chevron base)
steps.instruction: Skip first chain. Single crochet 2 together over next 2 chains. Single crochet in next 4 chains. Work 3 sc into the next chain (peak). Sc in next 4 chains. Skip 2 chains. Repeat the valley-peak pattern across.

steps.title: Row 2 (colour A)
steps.instruction: Chain 1 and turn. Single crochet across working into the back loop only for ridge texture.

steps.title: Switch to colour B
steps.instruction: At the end of row 2, drop colour A and pull through colour B for a clean change.

steps.title: Rows 3 to 4 (colour B)
steps.instruction: Repeat rows 1 and 2 with colour B.

steps.title: Continue stripes
steps.instruction: Alternate 2 rows of colour A and 2 rows of colour B for a total of 16 rows.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave in all ends. The chevron naturally creates a textured, scrubby surface.
